response.sql: WITH gender_counts AS (SELECT c.gender, COUNT(*) AS invoice_count FROM Invoices AS i INNER JOIN Orders AS o ON o.order_id = i.order_id INNER JOIN Customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.gender), overall_average AS (SELECT AVG(invoice_count) AS average_count FROM gender_counts) SELECT AVG(gc.invoice_count) AS average_above_average_count, AVG(gc.invoice_count - oa.average_count) AS average_excess FROM gender_counts AS gc CROSS JOIN overall_average AS oa WHERE gc.invoice_count > oa.average_count;
